purpose: Derive phase-current design requirements from torque/back-EMF evidence without equating DC and phase current.

reference_class_match.interpretation: The previous X13 18S electrical constants are a bounded proxy, not proof that X13 G2 has identical winding parameters.

proxy_electrical_constants.note: R/L/M are retained for S1.2 investigation only; S1.1 current closure uses the two published back-EMF constants.

torque_constant_model.assumption: Published back-EMF constants treated as line-to-line quantities for a sinusoidal PMSM/BLDC bounding model.
torque_constant_model.uncertainty_policy: Use the lower torque constant for upper-current sizing; do not select one source constant as exact until production-motor characterization.

frozen_design_requirements.continuous_requirement_basis: 27 kg rated-point upper model 105.48 A RMS x 1.15 = 121.30 A RMS, rounded upward; also covers modeled 30.252 kgf controlled-landing point before physical correlation.
frozen_design_requirements.overload_requirement_basis: Published curve maximum upper model 236.76 A RMS x 1.10 = 260.43 A RMS, rounded upward.
frozen_design_requirements.peak_basis: 265 A RMS x sqrt(2) = 374.77 A peak.
frozen_design_requirements.sense_basis: Measurement range must exceed the 375 A instantaneous phase design peak; exact shunt/CSA and OCP trip level remain G2/S1.4 work.

still_open: exact MOSFET MPN and parallel count
required_physical_correlation: production motor inductance versus rotor position where relevant
phase RMS/peak current at hover rated and maneuver points
anti_hallucination_rule: These values are conservative U1 design-capability requirements derived from source-backed reference data. They are not measured custom-UAV phase currents and do not constitute bench, dyno, thermal or flight validation.
